newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE HAS REFINERY FIRE, OUTPUT NOT HIT.
newsitem.headline: NESTE HAS REFINERY FIRE, OUTPUT NOT HIT.

text.p: Finnish energy group Neste Oy said on Friday a fire broke out at its Naantali refinery in southern Finland on Friday but production was not interrupted and the refinery suffered only slight damage.
"Refining was uninterrupted," Neste spokesman Matti Salminen said by telephone. "From what we can see now there is only minor damage."
The refinery has a capacity of around 40,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
Salminen said the fire had been caused by a leak in a unit for solvent aromates depletion, but had been brought under control quickly and was soon extinguished.
